_doc: Hand-entered Paladin effects (Forever). Healer tags: heal/direct/instant; tank tags: tank/shield/threat; ret tags: weapon:2h, ability:Seals, ability:Judgements, ability:Holy Strike.

Unyielding Faith.note: -15%/rank fear/disorient duration. PvP (2026-09-27): high, resist: Fears and disorients on you last 30% shorter (Classic: a 10% resist chance): Fear, Psychic Scream, Intimidating Shout and Scatter Shot are the main control used on paladins. Core of the Forever shockadin draft.

Voice of Truth.note: 6s silence/interrupt immunity every 3 min: healer utility on interrupt-heavy fights, leveling caster utility. 2026-09-27 audit: silence and interrupt immunity while casting: healer model only (melee Retribution is not interrupted). Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Infusion of Light.note: Holy Shock/Flash of Light crits cut the next Holy Light by 0.5s/rank: ~30% of Holy Lights get the cut at raid crit -> +6%/rank Holy Light throughput. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 3.4% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 2.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (2.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Illumination.note: 20%/rank chance for 50% of base mana back on crit heals (est. 100% chance at 5/5): refund = chance x 0.5 x crit (22%) -> +2.2%/rank mana. Half of Classic's Illumination. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Divine Favor.note: Guaranteed crit heal every 2 min: +1% healing, +1% mana. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 3.4% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 4.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (4.2%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-30, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, ret-dps, training dummy): removing it costs -1.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Holy Shock.note: Instant heal or damage every 10s: +3% healing (an instant on the move) and +5% Holy damage while leveling. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs -1.4% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Consecrated Ground.note: +5%/rank Holy damage vs the first 4 enemies in Consecration: leveling/tank AoE. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Light's Vigil.note: Marked target: next Holy Shock has no cooldown, party heal and mana refund on enemies -> +6% healing, +2% mana. 2026-09-27 audit: healing and mana while healing: healer model only (its sustain gave Retribution +0.8 in raid). PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Pre-cast on the target (1.5 s cast, lasts 30 s): the next Holy Shock on it triggers no cooldown, so two Holy Shocks land back to back plus 380-410 Holy damage (rank 3), or the whole party is healed for 684-724. Doubles the shockadin's instant burst; audit said medium, raised because the Forever draft is built on it. Beta numbers.

Redoubt.note: Beta curve: 2%/rank chance on being hit for +6%/rank block chance, 10s or 5 blocks. A tank takes ~1 hit per 2s -> at 5/5 a proc every ~20s and ~50% uptime x 30% block = +15% block chance, a block removing ~30% of a hit -> ~-4% damage taken at 5/5, ~1%/rank; tanks only. Tank (prot-tank, 2026-09-27): the tooltip estimate again; the simulator's Protection rotation checks the RedoubtTriggered aura, so its removal run (-1.3%) is not the talent's value and the raid calibration leaves this entry alone.

Improved Seal of Fury.note: Mana back when the Seal of Fury shield breaks: tank mana.

Improved Righteous Fury.note: -2%/rank damage taken with Righteous Fury: +2%/rank effective health for tanks. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 3.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.6%). Other modes unchanged.

Shield Specialization.note: +10%/rank block value (~+1%/rank mitigation) and 33%/rank chance for 6% mana on block. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 2.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Templar's Bulwark.note: Absorb equal to 100% max health for 8s every 5 min: ~6% effective health; Holy Shield prerequisite. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 2.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Reckoning.note: 8%/rank extra attack on block, 20%/rank on being crit: a tank blocks ~30% of hits -> +2.5%/rank white swings. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: Extra swings after being crit (100%, non-periodic) or after blocking (40%, shield only): players crit far more than mobs, and its damage is counted only in tank mode. If the charges bank as in Classic, a two-hander Reckoning bomb (unverified). Melee. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.7% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.38 to match (0.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 3.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 7.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 7.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (7.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Vindication.note: AP debuff on the target and +1%/rank own AP: tiny damage, some leveling survivability. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 1.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (1.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Sanctified Judgement.note: 33%/rank chance to refund 20% of the seal's mana on Judgement: ~+2%/rank mana for seal users. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 4.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.1% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x25.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (0.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Seal of Command.note: 70% weapon-damage Holy procs replace Seal of Righteousness: ~+15% total damage for a two-hander. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 12.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (11.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Pursuit of Justice.note: +8%/rank movement speed: travel time. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-26, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.1% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (1.7%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: run speed is travel, which the fight lab keeps fixed (6 s per kill), so it is no longer fitted: 8% / 15% speed x 6 s travel per ~34 s kill saves 0.44 / 0.78 s -> [0.013, 0.023]; pulls of several mobs travel less per kill -> [0.0035, 0.006]. PvP (2026-09-27): high, move: +15% run and mount speed, the paladin's only mobility (no gap closer, no sprint); 15% beats the 8% Minor Speed boot enchant it does not stack with. Core of the Forever shockadin draft.

Eye for an Eye.note: Reflects 5%/rank of crits taken: nothing measurable. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: Attackers take 10% of every critical strike they land on you, capped at half your health (Classic: 30% of spell crits only): about 100 damage per enemy crit. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.5% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Repentance.note: 6s incapacitate every minute: leveling/dungeon control. 2026-09-27 audit: humanoids only (35-46% of spawns) and any damage wakes it: 0.003 single-target, nothing in AoE pulls (Consecration wakes it). PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: 6 s incapacitate on a 1 min cooldown; every player is humanoid (shapeshifted druids aside): peel a melee, lock a healer, drink, or open with a double-damage Judgement of Command (unverified). Retribution tier 5 (20 points).

Champion of the Light.note: +33%/rank of Intellect as spell damage and healing (est.): ~150 Intellect -> +50 spell power per rank = ~+4%/rank Holy damage (Judgements/Consecration/Holy Strike) and ~+4%/rank healing. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.0% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.42 to match (2.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Twist of Light.note: Build 70009 adds -20% Seal mana cost (parsed). Seal twisting Echoes: an extra seal proc on the swing after each seal swap; mechanics untested, valued as ~+6% Retribution damage pending beta testing. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.2% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Other modes unchanged.

Sacred Arbiter.note: Build 70009: +20% Holy Strike (parsed; was 10%) and Holy Strike refreshes all Judgement effects on the target -> fewer re-Judgements (~+10% Judgement throughput). Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 4.1% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.65 to match (2.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Vengeance.note: Build 70009: +1%/rank Physical and Holy damage per stack after a non-periodic crit, 3 stacks (was 5), 30s: 3/6/9% at full stacks x ~80% uptime at raid crit. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 4.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 4.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (4.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Instrument of Law.note: Faster Hammer of Wrath, -10% threat: small. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 3.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.25 to match (0.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Guardian's Favor.note: Blessing of Protection/Freedom improvements: healer utility. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Blessing of Freedom 10 -> 16 s on its 20 s cooldown (snare and root immunity 80% of the time: leave melee or stay on a kiter) and Blessing of Protection every 3 min instead of 5. Protection tier 2 (5 points).

Sacred Duty.note: Parsed +2%/rank Stamina; the -30s cooldown on Divine Shield/Protection/Templar's Bulwark adds survivability. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, defensive: Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Templar's Bulwark 60 s shorter (5 -> 4 min): a quarter more bubbles over a battleground. The 4% Stamina is in the survival term.

Swift Judgement.note: Resets Judgement and makes the next one free every ~1 min: +15% Judgement output, some mana. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (0.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Hammer of Justice.note: Stun cooldown: utility. 2026-09-27 audit: Hammer of Justice interrupts casting adds: 0.002/rank tank utility. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: Hammer of Justice (6 s stun) every 45 s instead of 60 s: the paladin's only stun, and each stun is a double-damage Judgement of Command window. Protection tier 4 (15 points).

Purifying Power.note: Cheaper Cleanse, faster Exorcism/Holy Wrath: small. 2026-09-27 audit: Exorcism and Holy Wrath hit only Undead/Demons and the loop never casts them: 0.002/rank. PvP (2026-09-27): low, dispel: Cleanse and Purify 20% cheaper: more dispels per mana bar, not new ones; the Exorcism/Holy Wrath cooldown half only hits Undead and Demons (warlock pets). Audit said medium; lowered because the gain is mana only. Healers.

Spiritual Focus.note: 35%/rank pushback resistance on heals: ~+1%/rank raid healer throughput. PvP (2026-09-27): high, resist: 70% chance that Flash of Light, Holy Light and Light's Vigil lose no cast time when you are hit (with Concentration Aura's 35%, no pushback at all if they add as in Classic): healing through melee and DoT pressure. Healers and shockadin; Retribution only for self-heals.

Toughness.note: +2%/rank armor from items: ~8000 item armor tank -> +800 at 5/5 -> physical damage taken ~-5.8% (armor DR 63.6% -> 65.7%) -> +1.1%/rank effective health. Wowhead classic prot guide: 'Toughness improves your physical damage mitigation'. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Anticipation.note: +4 defense/rank (Forever doubles Classic): +0.04% dodge/parry/block/miss and -0.04% crit taken per point -> +1.6% avoidance, -0.4% crit at 5/5 -> ~+3% effective health for a tank (0.6%/rank). Wowhead: 'defense skill, which is the main stat tanks desire'; 'less valuable as your gear improves'. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, prot-tank): removing it costs 2.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.0%).
